page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Above the text: page number at the top left and a running head at the top centre.

main_text.p: banus Trib. pleb. legem tu-lit; ut ei Imperium abroga-retur: accersitur Maiestatis. I. Maiestatem minuisti. D. Non minui. Q. An minuerit. R. Quia populi Ro. dolor iustus, vim tum illam excitauit, non Tribuni actio. » Maiestas autem, quoniam est magnitudo quædam populi Ro. in eius potestate ac iure retinendo, aucta est potius quàm diminuta. F. » Imò maiestas est Imperij, atque in omni populi Ro. dignitate. quam minuit is, qui per vim multitudinis rem ad seditionem vocauit. D. » Minuerit ne Maiestatem, qui

page.notes: The first word "banus" is a fragment from the line above the text block and is kept as printed. Handwriting and ink stains in the left margin (around the line beginning "Q. An minuerit") are not printed text and are left out. The running head is heavily worn; its words after "SEL." could not be read. The page number's first digit is faint. The "»" marks at line starts are printed quotation or speaker marks and are kept. Spelling is as printed (e.g. "auêta" is read as "aucta" with the ligature uncertain; the circumflex on the e may be a printing or ink artifact).
